chunks: For them is an abode of peace with their Lord. He will be their defender as reward for what they did.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Dar al-Salam in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Dar al-Salam' is interpreted not merely as a physical abode but as the ultimate state of spiritual tranquility and proximity to the Divine, achieved through the purification of the soul. This verse highlights God's role as the ultimate guardian (Wali) who validates the deeds of the righteous, a concept deeply linked to the Imamate as the earthly manifestation of divine guardianship. The reward is thus seen as both a consequence of action and a gift of divine grace, reflecting the balance between justice and mercy in Shia theology.
